description: Xugrid is a Deltares extension to xarray for working with two-dimensional unstructured grids. It represents data and mesh topology following UGRID conventions, allowing users to select cross sections and plot fields while retaining the relationships between faces and coordinates. The README provides a Python example using a Netherlands elevation mesh and links installation and API documentation. Coverage is otherwise global and user-defined; grid resolution and dates belong to the supplied model data, not to the package. Source and package installation are public and free under MIT. A limitation is the documented focus on two-dimensional UGRID structures, which should not be interpreted as support for every mesh or simulator format. The example establishes the interface but not numerical accuracy for a user's interpolation or model evaluation. Xugrid can help prepare and inspect unstructured hydraulic results around Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm), and the separately documented dfm_tools package explicitly uses it. No mesh, data array or simulator output was downloaded in this review.
